title: Guardana Dataset v1
description: One record of a Guardana quality suite's dataset, format 1. The file is JSONL: the first non-blank line is the header, every later non-blank line is one case. Each line validates against this schema independently; that the header comes first, that a file holds at least one case, that a `reply` appears only in a rule's fixture dataset, and that no two cases are the same input graded against the same expectation are checked by the reader.

header.description: The first record: the dataset's name and the version its author gives it.

case.description: One case: what is sent, and what the reply is graded against on top of the suite's own expectation.

expect.description: The evaluator's fields for this case, overlaid on the suite's `expect:`; which fields are legal depends on the evaluator.

reply.description: The scripted answer to this case; only in a rule's fixture dataset.

input.description: One user message as a string, or the messages in order; the last must be from the user, which the reader checks.

tags.description: Labels for the case; the `sample:` and `declined:` prefixes are reserved for the suite.
